definitions.explanation: A visual representation of an area.

examples.japanese: {地図|ちず}を{見|み}て{道|みち}を{探|さが}す。
examples.english: To look for a road by looking at the map.

examples.japanese: スマホで{地図|ちず}アプリを{使|つか}う。
examples.english: To use a map app on a smartphone.

notes:
{地図|ちず} means map.

TYPES:
- {世界|せかい}{地図|ちず} (world map)
- {道路|どうろ}{地図|ちず} (road map)
- {地図|ちず}アプリ (map app)

COMMON PHRASES:
- {地図|ちず}を{見|み}る (to look at a map)
- {地図|ちず}を{描|か}く (to draw a map)
- {地図|ちず}を{読|よ}む (to read a map)
